seo.title: Jacksonville, FL RV Rental Market
seo.description: Jacksonville, FL RV rental prices: median $130/night across 391 Outdoorsy & RVshare listings. Live market benchmarks for hosts.
seo.introHtml:
Jacksonville, FL RV rental hosts currently compete across 391 active listings on Outdoorsy and RVshare within a 35-mile radius. The median asking rate is $130/night (average $160), a $30 premium of the mean over the median that signals how skewed high-end inventory is.

Platform mix is roughly 41% Outdoorsy / 59% RVshare (161 vs 230). By class: Travel Trailer median $120 (212 listings); Class C median $182 (56 listings); Fifth Wheel median $170 (55 listings). 89% of listings offer delivery; 42% are instant book.

Figures are computed from active geo-scoped listings with a positive nightly rate. Use this page as a pricing baseline, then refine against comps in your class, length, and amenity bundle.

faq.question: What is the average RV rental rate in Jacksonville?
faq.answer: The average asking rate in Jacksonville, FL is $160 per night; the median is $130 (P25 $115 · P75 $180) across 391 active listings.

faq.question: How many RV rentals are listed in Jacksonville?
faq.answer: RVIntel currently tracks 391 active listings in the Jacksonville, FL market window (35 mi): 161 on Outdoorsy and 230 on RVshare.

faq.question: Is Outdoorsy or RVshare larger in Jacksonville?
faq.answer: RVshare currently has more inventory in Jacksonville, FL (230 vs 161 on Outdoorsy). Many hosts list on both.
